headline: Bitcoin Trades Near $80,200 as Elevated Oil Prices and Rate Fears Weigh
summary: Bitcoin traded around $80,200 as surging oil prices and interest rate concerns dented investor appetite for cryptocurrencies.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a barometer for broader risk-on sentiment in digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Concerns over elevated energy prices and sticky interest rates reduce investor appetite for speculative digital assets.

why_moved: Rising oil prices heighten macroeconomic risk and interest rate worries, dampening demand for higher-risk speculative assets like cryptocurrencies.
